_comment: T66b Step 5b: why a state-changing entry has no transaction of its own (coverage.py note --reasons). {contract label or *: {signature glob: reason}}; the first match wins, the contract's own rows before *. A reason names what stops the call, never 'not done'.

GovernanceRouter.executeMetaTransaction(*: refused by design: the router has no generic path (governance spec §3.6, B-14); its negative MtxSelectorNotAllowed runs (gov)
GovernanceRouter.mtxExecute(*: refused by design: the router has no generic path (governance spec §3.6, B-14); its negative MtxSelectorNotAllowed runs (gov)
GovernanceRouter.mtxBatch(*: refused by design: the router has no generic path (governance spec §3.6, B-14); its negative MtxSelectorNotAllowed runs (gov)
GovernanceRouter.mtxExecuteRate(*: waits the token's rate delay (2 days) after mtxProposeRate; a real chain cannot skip time: its negative RateChangeNotReady runs (gov)
GovernanceRouter.mtxCreateInstance(*: needs a class release on the deploy's factory, and deploy.sh publishes none (misc's own factory runs createInstance directly); through the router: its negative ReleaseUnknown runs (gov)

MandateWallet.executeMetaTransaction(*: refused by design (an address meta-transaction: none is taken); its negative runs (misc)

SmartKeyAccount.completeRecovery(*: waits RECOVERY_DELAY (2 days) after initiateRecovery; a real chain cannot skip time: its negative runs (gov)

*.initialize(*: the factory's own call on a fresh clone (OpenFactory.createToken / createDex / createInstance, SmartKeyAccountFactory.deploy): runs inside those transactions; a second call is refused (initialised)
*.executeRate(): waits the token's rate delay (2 days) after proposeRate; a real chain cannot skip time: its negative RateChangeNotReady runs (tokens)
